title: a11y progressive disclosure: node list on window-grap, content only on node-grap
desc: Design intent: window-level grap returns node structure only (roles+names), not content. Content exposed only when a specific node is addressed. Forces AI to understand node importance before extracting data -- mirrors how screen readers work.
steps: INTENT: Window-grap query returns accessibility tree structure (roles, names, counts) not content. AI must navigate to a specific node to get content. Screen reader users Tab through nodes to understand layout first -- AI should do the same. This builds correct mental model and produces node-targeted automation instead of fragile text-grep patterns.

CURRENT-PROBLEM: a11y read {window-grap} dumps full page text. AI grep-searches it and bypasses the accessibility tree entirely. Node roles, structure, hierarchy all ignored. Result: brittle automation based on text matching instead of node targeting.

PROPOSED-BEHAVIOR: a11y read {window-grap-only} = window grap with NO scope segment = returns node list only (structure). a11y read {window-grap}#scope = with scope = returns actual content of that node only.

EXAMPLE-STRUCTURE: wkappbot a11y read "{domain:'example.ai'}" (window-only grap, no scope) OUTPUT: [Document] page-title / [Group] chat-area / [Edit] input placeholder=Ask anything / [Button] Send / [Group] conversation-history (2 items) / [Button] New chat. AI sees roles+counts -- enough to decide which node to target next. No conversation content leaked.

EXAMPLE-CONTENT: wkappbot a11y read "{domain:'example.ai'}#*conversation*" (node-scoped) OUTPUT: [Message user] hello / [Message assistant] Hello how can I help you. Content revealed only after explicit node navigation.
ANALOGY: filesystem ls shows directory structure not file contents. cat path/file shows content only after explicit navigation. Same: a11y structure first, content on explicit node address.
ESCAPE-HATCH: --content flag on window-grap preserves full-dump for existing scripts. a11y inspect always full UIA dump for debugging. Opt-in migration -- no breaking change on day one.

IMPACT: AI learns Edit=input surface, Button=action, Group=container with sub-items. Token waste reduced -- only targeted content loaded. Automation quality improves naturally as AI is forced to understand structure.

IMPLEMENTED v7.3.85 (2026-05-19): A11yReadNodeList added to A11yActions.Read.cs. Window-grap-only read returns: (1) [Document] Title (total N nodes) header, (2) named/actionable nodes only -- unnamed Group/Pane/Custom containers skipped silently, (3) Edit/ComboBox/Search ALWAYS shown as [PINNED] even when in compressed middle section, (4) unnamed Image nodes hidden, (5) Edit nodes show placeholder= attribute, (6) action hints: Edit->a11y type Button/Link->a11y invoke, (7) 8+8 head/tail compression with ** (N more) ** marker, (8) --content flag restores full dump for backward compat. Validated: duck.ai shows [Edit] placeholder + consent button = AI plans full flow immediately. Naver: [PINNED] search input visible despite 51 compressed items.

COPY-PASTE COMMANDS (v7.3.86, 2026-05-19): Each actionable node in window-grap read now prints an indented copy-paste command. Edit/ComboBox: 'wkappbot a11y type {grap}#*placeholder* INPUT'. Button/Link: 'wkappbot a11y invoke {grap}#*name*'. Container: 'wkappbot a11y read {grap}#*name*'. CRITICAL: grap includes cdp:PORT field per CDP discipline -- {domain:'site.com',cdp:9740}#*node*. Port extracted from original query grap via ExtractNodeListWindowGrap. Pinned Edit nodes always show even when compressed. Validated on naver.com/duck.ai/github.com.

CI VALIDATION (2026-05-19): Legacy app test A01 caught real encoding bug -- Korean placeholder text (HelpText from UIA) displays as mojibake in node list output. Filed suggest. A02/A03 tests show cmd-slash-c capture returns LAUNCH JSON not node content in CI (v7.3.1 limitation). Action hints absent in CI node list. All findings documented as known issues pending SDK release upgrade.

FOCUSED NODE MARKER (design rule): a11y read node list MUST preserve document order (natural UIA tree traversal). Do NOT reorder nodes based on focus. Instead, mark the currently focused node inline with a [FOCUSED] prefix at its natural position. Reordering = accessibility violation = test FAIL. Screen readers depend on consistent document order. [FOCUSED] marker only; position unchanged.

Z-ORDER RULE (corrected 2026-05-19): a11y read node list output order follows UIA Z-order traversal (frontmost element first), NOT arbitrary document order. This is the correct accessibility rule: screen readers read foreground/topmost elements first. Modal dialogs and popups are Z-order front, so they naturally appear first in output. Focused node gets [FOCUSED] marker at its natural Z-order position -- no reordering needed. Reordering by document order would violate Z-order rules and must FAIL accessibility tests.

BLOCKER PREFIX (2026-05-19): When a blocking overlay (cookie banner, consent dialog, modal popup) is detected in Z-order front position, prefix it with [BLOCKER] in node list output BEFORE the main content nodes. Priority: [BLOCKER] first -> [FOCUSED] in Z-order position -> rest in Z-order. Integrates with experience/brokers/ DB for known blocker patterns. Heuristic for unknowns: top Z-order + covers large area + has dismiss/accept button. AI workflow: see [BLOCKER] -> invoke dismiss button -> re-read -> [BLOCKER] gone -> proceed with main content. This is the correct accessibility interaction pattern for overlays.

BLOCKER-PREFIX STATUS (2026-05-20): stub inserted in A11yActions.Read.cs in previous session but full DetectBlockerNodes() implementation not yet complete. Next implementation steps: (1) implement DetectBlockerNodes() detecting modal/dialog/consent/overlay by UIA ControlType+Name pattern and CDP role=dialog/aria-modal; (2) prefix matching nodes with [BLOCKER] in node list output; (3) add broker overlay screenshots to bin/wkappbot.hq/experience/brokers/; (4) build + verify on duck.ai cookie consent banner.

2026-05-20: starting BLOCKER prefix implementation. New partial class A11yActions.Blocker.cs with DetectBlockerNodes() (UIA Dialog/Pane+name regex, CDP role=dialog/aria-modal/class~modal). Node-list emit in A11yActions.Read.cs prepends [BLOCKER] for matching IDs. Delegated to Opus agent in Core repo D:/GitHub/WKAppBot.

BLOCKER PREFIX SHIPPED (v7.3.120, 2026-05-20): DetectBlockerNodes() implemented in A11yActions.Blocker.cs partial class. UIA path: ControlType=Dialog/alertdialog/alert, Window/Pane/Group/Custom with name matching blocker regex (cookie/consent/accept/agree/gdpr/modal/overlay/dialog/popup/banner/privacy). CDP path: when browser hwnd + cdp port present, eval JS scans DOM for [role=dialog], [role=alertdialog], [aria-modal=true], class~=modal/overlay/backdrop/cookie-banner/consent (size>=50x30). Harvested DOM names are matched against UIA node names by substring; matched runtime IDs added to set. Emit loop in CollectNodeLines prepends [BLOCKER] before [FOCUSED] before typeLabel. Verified on bbc.com with injected role=dialog cookie-consent: output shows '[BLOCKER] [Dialog] Cookie Consent Banner' followed by Accept/Reject child buttons with copy-paste a11y invoke commands. Workflow: AI sees [BLOCKER] -> invokes dismiss button -> re-read -> [BLOCKER] gone -> proceed.

requirements.expect: Edit Button Group visible without conversation content
